stem: The equation \(x^{2} - 10x + 18 = 0\) has solutions \(p\) and \(q\), where \(p > q\). What is the value of \((p - q)^{2}\)?
solution: For \(x^{2} - 10x + 18 = 0\), the sum of the solutions is \(p + q = 10\) and the product is \(pq = 18\).
Alternatively, the solutions are \(5 \pm \sqrt{7}\), so \(p - q = 2\sqrt{7}\) and \((p - q)^{2} = 28\).
verify:
x = symbols('x')
p, q = sorted(solve(Eq(x**2 - 10*x + 18, 0), x), reverse=True)
assert simplify((p - q)**2) == 28
assert Rational(spr_answers[0]) == 28
